decision_point: After every terminal RUN and before next RUN admission
may_continue_if_all: reserved run count and all cumulative/concurrent budgets within bounds
claim and subordinate intents classified; no replay
all owned resources proven stopped or safely isolated
evidence store and session ledger healthy
no foreign ownership mutation or host exclusivity compromise
uncertainty: If run claim/effect ambiguous, close RUN permanently. SESSION continues only after independent proof uncertainty cannot contaminate session/host/budgets; otherwise quarantine.
next_run: Fresh RUN_ID, CLAIM_ID, ATTEMPT_ID, NAMESPACE_ID and explicit run authority; never reuse/reset consumed slot.
